strings.app.name: HexCleaner
strings.window.title: HexCleaner
strings.header.subtitle: Windows junk and cache cleaner
strings.header.run_as_admin.hint: Restart the program with administrator rights (UAC).
strings.header.languages_folder.hint: Put your own translation file (*.json) here and it will appear in this list. Samples ru.json and en.json are already there.
strings.list.admin_hint: Items with a shield need administrator rights and will be skipped.
strings.locations.more: …and {count} more folders. See the log for the full list.
strings.footer.analyze.hint: Show how much junk would be removed and where. Deletes nothing.
strings.footer.compress_logs.hint: Before a new cleanup, pack the logs of previous cleanups into zip archives.
strings.status.ready: Check the items you need. “Analyze” shows how much junk there is without deleting anything.
strings.status.analysis_done: Analysis complete: {files} files found, {size} can be freed. Click the triangle next to an item to see the folders.
strings.status.analysis_stopped: Analysis stopped: {files} files found, {size} can be freed.
strings.status.failed: . Could not delete {count} (in use or access denied)
strings.status.elevation_failed: Could not get administrator rights (the UAC prompt was declined).
strings.note.memory_in_analysis: freed memory is known only after cleanup
strings.skip.link: link to another folder, left untouched
strings.failure.loaded: running as a program or loaded as a library
strings.failure.loaded_by_one: running or loaded as a library by process {processes}
strings.failure.loaded_by_many: running or loaded as a library by processes {processes}
strings.failure.delete_pending: already being deleted: it will disappear when the program holding it closes it
strings.log.admin_no: Administrator rights: no — items that need them will be skipped
strings.log.total_clean: TOTAL: {files} files deleted, {size} freed, {failed} could not be deleted
strings.log.total_analysis: TOTAL: {files} files found, {size} can be freed
strings.log.event_logs_summary: event logs cleared: {cleared}, skipped (active or protected): {skipped}
strings.task.memory.title: Free RAM used by background processes
strings.task.memory.description: Asks Windows to page out unused memory of all processes (EmptyWorkingSet). No process is terminated.
strings.task.games_gpu_cache.title: Clean game, Steam, Epic Games and NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPU caches
strings.task.games_gpu_cache.description: DirectX / OpenGL / Vulkan shader caches, launcher web caches and logs. Games and saves are not touched. Shader caches are rebuilt the next time you play.
strings.task.installers_cache.title: Clean NVIDIA (Installer2) and Microsoft Office (MSOCache) installer caches
strings.task.installers_cache.description: Unpacked old NVIDIA driver packages and the local copy of the Office installer. Repairing Office may then require the installation media.
strings.task.browsers_cache.title: Clean Chrome, Edge, Opera, Firefox, Yandex and other browser caches
strings.task.browsers_cache.description: Page, script and shader caches only. Cookies, history, passwords, bookmarks and extensions are not touched. Close the browsers for a complete cleanup.
strings.task.explorer_cache.title: Clean Explorer thumbnail and icon caches
strings.task.explorer_cache.description: Picture and video thumbnails, icon cache. Windows recreates them as needed. Files kept open by Explorer are skipped.
strings.task.defender_cache.title: Clean Windows Defender scan history and logs
strings.task.defender_cache.description: Scan history and Defender service logs. Quarantine and signature databases are not touched. With Tamper Protection on, some files are skipped.
strings.task.windows_setup_cache.title: Clean Windows setup cache
strings.task.windows_setup_cache.description: Windows Installer patch cache and leftovers of downloads for upgrading to a new Windows version.
strings.task.windows_update_cache.title: Clean Windows Update cache
strings.task.windows_update_cache.description: Downloaded Windows Update packages and the Delivery Optimization cache. Update services are stopped during the cleanup.
strings.task.system_logs.title: Clear Windows system logs
strings.task.system_logs.description: Windows event logs and text logs of system setup and servicing.
strings.task.driver_leftovers.title: Remove NVIDIA / AMD / Intel installer leftovers
strings.task.driver_leftovers.description: The C:\NVIDIA and C:\AMD folders where driver installers unpack themselves, and the C:\Intel\Logs logs. Installed drivers are not touched.
strings.task.user_temp.title: Delete user temporary files
strings.task.user_temp.description: The %TEMP% folder. Files younger than one hour and files in use are skipped.
strings.task.system_temp.title: Delete Windows temporary files
strings.task.system_temp.description: Temporary folders of Windows and system services. Files younger than one hour and files in use are skipped.
strings.task.diagnostics.title: Delete Windows diagnostic files
strings.task.diagnostics.description: Diagnostic and telemetry traces (ETL), power usage reports.
strings.task.user_reports.title: Delete program error reports and crash dumps
strings.task.user_reports.description: Windows Error Reporting reports and crash dumps of the current user's programs.
strings.task.system_reports.title: Delete system error reports and memory dumps
strings.task.system_reports.description: System Windows Error Reporting reports, minidumps and the full memory dump after a BSOD.
